{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Red Star engages in a robust internal critique of many international political projects.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The purpose of Red Star's internal critique of international political projects is to learn scientifically and emulate winning strategies for enacting a proletarian dictatorship over capital in the US.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Until Red Star and DSA gain power, the question of which other countries are worthy of their support is a distraction at best and chauvinism at worst.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The opportunity to learn scientifically from projects abroad vastly eclipses any ground to be gained with the working class by engaging in nationalist nuance around actually existing socialist states and projects.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is in its utter infancy in comparison to the majority of international projects.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Red Star rejects western chauvinism from both political powers and within its own ranks.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Red Star believes in the creative, historical power of revolution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Red Star rejects western chauvinism.",
